channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-08-07 — late-cycle
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 314¢/lb — down 5.6% on the week and down 12.1% on the month. The regime model reads the market as late-cycle (selective posture) and has for 24 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (+0.5σ). The crop is in its fruit filling window, and stage-weighted stress is low. The Brazilian real is little changed on the month (-0.8%) — a neutral currency backdrop.
